field_changes.before: City Council adopted Ordinance 905 by a 6-0 vote on 2026-06-29, effective immediately.
field_changes.after: June 29, 2026: City Council minutes report unanimous adoption of Ordinance 905 and list six councilmembers present. The ordinance states immediate effectiveness upon passage.

field_changes.before: One-year moratorium in all city districts on accepting, processing, or approving applications to establish, expand, or change a use to a data center with capacity exceeding 20 MVA. Preserves vested rights for complete permit applications filed before the effective date. Public hearing scheduled for 2026-07-13.
